issue_context.title: br: support pause/resume stream task in PiTR
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Need to support `br stream pause ...` and `br stream resume ...` to pause and resume a stream task.
This is a subtask in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/29501
